name: default-task-routing
rules: WHEN task.type ∈ {research,summarize} → claude-sonnet-4; fallback deepseek-v3; escalate claude-opus-4 IF confidence < 0.6

name: cheap-night-shift
rules: WHEN hour ∈ [00,07] AND task.cost_class = low → ollama/qwen2.5:32b; cap $0.10/run

name: code-escalation
rules: WHEN task.type = code → gpt-5; fallback openrouter/auto
